[[File:FC Suduroy vs Skala, Faroe Islands Cup 9 April 2012.jpg|thumb|Skála vs. [[FC Suðuroy]] in the [[2012 Faroe Islands Cup|Faroe Islands Cup 2012]]]]

[[File:Kvinnufótbóltur 2012 FC Suðuroy - Skála.jpg|thumb|Skála also has a team in the women's top division. Here they are playing against [[FC Suðuroy]].]]

'''Skála Ítróttarfelag''' ('''Skála ÍF'''), or more commonly referred to as just '''Skála''', is a [[Faroe Islands|Faroese]] professional [[Football club (association football)|football club]] based in the village of [[Skáli|Skála]], [[Runavík Municipality|municipality of Runavík]]. The club currently plays in '''[[Faroe Islands Premier League|Meistaradeildin]]''', the top division of the [[Football in the Faroe Islands|Faroese football league]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=FaroeSoccer {{!}} Føroysk Fótbóltshagtøl |url=https://www.faroesoccer.com/kappingar/menn/meistaradeildin/ |access-date=2026-04-06 |website=FaroeSoccer.com |language=fo|url-status=live|date=2026-04-06|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260406183430/https://www.faroesoccer.com/kappingar/menn/meistaradeildin/|archive-date=2026-04-06}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=MeistaraDeildin menn |url=https://www.fsf.fo/kappingar-og-urslit/menn/meistaradeildin-menn/ |access-date=2026-04-06 |website=Fótbóltssamband Føroya |language=fo|date=2026-04-06|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260208172450/https://www.fsf.fo/kappingar-og-urslit/menn/meistaradeildin-menn/|archive-date=2026-02-08|url-status=live}}</ref> The club was founded on 15 May 1965.

They were promoted to the top division after winning the 2015 season of 1. deild with 70 points. They were also promoted to the top tier after the 2013 season,<ref name="Skala_upp">{{cite web |url=http://www.faroesoccer.com/news/read.php?psec=18&NewsListPage=14&page=456 |title=B68 og Skála upp og B71 niður |date=2 October 2013 |publisher=Faroesoccer.com |language=Faroese |accessdate=13 April 2017}}</ref> but were relegated after one season in the then-named Effodeildin.

The 2005 season was the best in the club's history, when Skála finished second and qualified for the [[2006–07 UEFA Cup]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-04-06 |title=Season 2006/07 Matches {{!}} UEFA Europa League 2006/07 |url=https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuropaleague/history/seasons/2006/matches/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250521115312/https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuropaleague/history/seasons/2006/matches/ |archive-date=2025-05-21 |access-date=2026-04-06 |website=UEFA.com |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-04-06 |title=History: Skála 0-1 Start {{!}} UEFA Europa League 2006/07 |url=https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuropaleague/match/84244--skala-vs-start/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241219051244/https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuropaleague/match/84244--skala-vs-start/ |archive-date=2024-12-19 |access-date=2026-04-06 |website=UEFA.com |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-04-06 |title=History: Start 3-0 Skála {{!}} UEFA Europa League 2006/07 |url=https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuropaleague/match/84245--start-vs-skala/ |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20241218052203/https://www.uefa.com/uefaeuropaleague/match/84245--start-vs-skala/ |archive-date=2024-12-18 |access-date=2026-04-06 |website=UEFA.com |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |date=2026-04-06 |title=FK Ventspils vs. GÍ Gøta and Skála vs. Start Kristansand |url=http://www.soccerandequipment.com/gi-ventspils-skala-start.html |url-status=live |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250219190609/http://www.soccerandequipment.com/gi-ventspils-skala-start.html |archive-date=2025-02-19 |access-date=2026-04-06 |website=www.soccerandequipment.com}}</ref>"}}
